99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.definition: The way a fact bears on the question being asked.
99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.gloss: The way a fact bears on the question being asked.

99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.definition: 어떤 사실이 현재 다루는 질문에 얼마나 직접적인 관련을 갖는지를 가리킨다. 모든 사실이 질문과 똑같은 관계를 가지는 것은 아니다.
99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.gloss: 사실이 질문에 얼마나 관계되는지를 나타내는 정도.

99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.definition: A relação entre um fato e uma pergunta ou questão. Um fato é relevante quando ajuda a respondê-la.
99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.gloss: A maneira como um fato se relaciona com a pergunta feita.

99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.definition: Cara sebuah fakta berkaitan dengan pertanyaan yang sedang ditanyakan. Sebuah fakta bisa benar tetapi tidak relevan, kalau tidak menyentuh apa yang sedang ditanyakan.
99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.gloss: Cara sebuah fakta berkaitan dengan pertanyaan yang sedang ditanyakan.

99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.definition: ความสัมพันธ์ของข้อเท็จจริงกับคำถามที่กำลังถาม ซึ่งบ่งชี้ว่าข้อมูลนั้นช่วยตอบคำถามได้หรือไม่
99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.gloss: ความเกี่ยวข้องของข้อเท็จจริงกับคำถาม

99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.definition: Bir olgunun sorulan soruyu ne ölçüde ilgilendirdiği. Bir bilginin soruya uygunluğunu belirtir.
99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.gloss: Bir olgunun sorulan soruyla ne ölçüde ilgili olduğu.

99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.translation: Hangi soruyu sorduğunuzu bildiğinizde günlüğün soruyla ilgisi açıkça anlaşılır.
เมื่อรู้ว่ากำลังถามคำถามอะไร ความเกี่ยวข้องของบันทึกก็จะชัดเจนขึ้น
Relevansi log itu jelas begitu Anda tahu pertanyaan mana yang sedang ditanyakan.
A relevância do registro fica clara quando se sabe qual pergunta está sendo feita.
어떤 문제를 묻는지 알고 나면 기록의 관련성이 분명해진다.

99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.text: The relevance of the log is clear once you know which question you are asking.
99045570dfa5b0e08dc3d541a6c9fbb41034d96b.translation: Mức độ liên quan của bản ghi rõ ràng khi bạn biết mình đang đặt câu hỏi gì.

995cf20a9c45daaf0a2cc31e85c290032ced97aa.definition: Nằm ngay trong mạch văn bản.
Set in line with the surrounding text.
995cf20a9c45daaf0a2cc31e85c290032ced97aa.gloss: Placed within the flow of the text.

997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.definition: The cold box in the kitchen. It keeps food fresh for a day or two.
997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.gloss: The cold box in the kitchen. It keeps food fresh for a day or two.

997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.definition: 厨房などに置く冷蔵庫で、食べ物や飲み物を冷やし、生の状態を保つ。
997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.gloss: 食べ物を冷たく保つ冷蔵庫。

997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.definition: 주방에 놓여 음식을 차갑게 유지하는 냉장장치로, 음식을 며칠 동안 신선하게 보존한다.
Aparelho da cozinha, geralmente com uma porta, que conserva os alimentos em baixa temperatura por algum tempo.
997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.gloss: Geladeira é o eletrodoméstico que mantém os alimentos frios e frescos.

997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.definition: Lemari dengan suhu dingin yang digunakan untuk menyimpan makanan dan minuman agar tetap segar._pendingin ini umumnya digunakan setiap hari di rumah.
997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.gloss: Lemari pendingin di dapur yang menjaga makanan tetap segar.

997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.definition: เครื่องใช้ไฟฟ้าที่มีอุณหภูมิเย็น ใช้เก็บอาหารและเครื่องดื่มให้ยังสด โดยทั่วไปอาหารจะอยู่ได้ประมาณหนึ่งถึงสองวัน
997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.gloss: ตู้เย็นสำหรับเก็บอาหาร

997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.definition: Mutfakta bulunan, içi soğuk tutulan ve yiyecekleri taze saklayan dolap. Buzdolabı, süt, et ve peynir gibi çabuk bozulan yiyecekler için kullanılır.
997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.gloss: Mutfaktaki soğuk dolap; yiyecekleri bir gün ya da iki gün taze tutar.

997bc249599b74191aa0ee6851d0945e291fd2c5.translation: Telur-telur itu ada di dalam lemari pendingin.

A lamp that shows a state.
99a7026172d42714d0293e5598ec1c8e8260d7d0.gloss: An indicator lamp on a dashboard.

99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.definition: The directions from which an attack may come, and the ground they must cross.
99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.gloss: The directions from which an attack may come, and the ground they must cross.

99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.definition: 敵が攻撃 frivolousてくる方向と、攻撃部隊が通過しなければならない地面。進攻方向と経路の両方を示す。
99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.gloss: 敵が攻撃してくる可能性がある方向と、その進撃路。

99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.definition: 적군이 공격해 올 수 있는 여러 방향과 그 공격이 통과해야 할 지형적인 길을 가리킨다. 지형에 따라 가능한 접근로가 제한된다.
99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.gloss: 공격이 들어올 수 있는 방향과 지나야 할 지형.

99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.definition: Em operações militares, são as vias pelas quais uma força pode avançar contra o adversário. O termo pode designar tanto as direções possíveis do ataque quanto os trajetos e terrenos efetivamente utilizados.
99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.gloss: As direções pelas quais um ataque pode chegar e os terrenos que precisam ser atravessados.

99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.definition: Arah atau jalur yang dapat digunakan oleh pasukan penyerang untuk mendekati sasaran. Medi yang dilalui dapat membatasi pilihan arah serangan.
99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.gloss: Arah dari mana serangan dapat datang dan medan yang harus dilalui.

99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.definition: ทิศทางที่การโจมตีอาจเข้ามา และพื้นที่ซึ่งกองทัพต้องผ่านเพื่อเข้าถึงเป้าหมาย ไม่ใช่เส้นทางที่กำหนดไว้ล่วงหน้าเพียงอย่างเดียว
99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.gloss: ทิศทางและพื้นที่ที่กองทัพต้องผ่านเพื่อเข้าโจมตี

99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.definition: Yaklaşma hatları, saldırının gerçekleştirilebileceği yönleri ve bu yönlerde aşılması gereken araziyi belirtir.
99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.gloss: Saldırının gelebileceği yönler ve kat edilmesi gereken arazi.

99be48885112459770f68b12b887679e023e5ef9.translation: พื้นที่หญิงป่าเสียกั้นแนวทางการเข้าโจมตีของกองทัพ
Rawa membatasi garis pendekatan sehingga serangan hanya dapat datang dari satu arah.

99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.definition: A figure measured in the money as printed, with no adjustment for prices.
99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.gloss: A figure measured in the money as printed, with no adjustment for prices.

99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.definition: 記載された金额そのままの額のこと。実質的な購買力袈く不符し、物価上昇 分だけ 実勢より少なくなることがある。
99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.gloss: 額面や表示された金額そのものの数字で、物価の変動を調整していない額。

99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.definition: 인플레이션이나 물가 변동을 조정하지 않고 지폐와 동전의 표시 금액만으로 계산한 수치를 말한다. 실제 구매력과는 다를 수 있다.
99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.gloss: 가격 변동을 반영하지 않고 표시된 금액만으로 측정한 수치.

99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.definition: Valor medido pelo montante indicado, sem ajustes que considerem ainflação ouChanges no poder de compra.
99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.gloss: Valor financeiro calculado sem considerar a variação dos preços.

99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.definition: Nominal berarti bernilai sesuai jumlah uang yang tercantum tanpa penyesuaian harga. Nilainya belum tentu mencerminkan daya beli karena harga dapat berubah.
99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.gloss: Nominal berarti bernilai sesuai jumlah uang yang tercantum tanpa penyesuaian harga.

99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.definition: ตัวเลขที่แสดงมูลค่าตามที่ระบุไว้ โดยไม่คำนึงถึงการเปลี่ยนแปลงของราคาสินค้า จึงอาจไม่สะท้อนกำลังซื้อที่แท้จริง
99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.gloss: มูลค่าที่คำนวณตามจำนวนเงินที่ระบุไว้โดยไม่ปรับตามราคา

99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.definition: Enflasyon veya fiyat değişimlerine göre düzeltme yapılmadan belirtilen nominal değer; özellikle nominal ücret ile gerçek satın alma gücü arasındaki farkı anlatır.
99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.gloss: Fiyat değişimlerine göre düzeltilmeden, üzerinde yazılı para miktarı olarak ölçülen değer.

99c41a908504fd5a84fd72328d392844fd0d5aab.translation: Nominal maaş 2.000 dolardır; bu, satın alma gücünün de 2.000 dolar olduğu anlamına gelmez.
เงินเดือนตามตัวเลขอยู่ที่ 2,000 ดอลลาร์ ซึ่งไม่เท่ากับกำลังซื้อที่ได้จริง
Gaji nominalnya 2.000 dolar, yang tidak sama dengan jumlah yang dapat dibelinya.

99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.definition: The habit of giving way to authority without asking for the reason.
99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.gloss: The habit of giving way to authority without asking for the reason.

99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.definition: 服従とは、理由を確かめずに、権威を持つ人の判断や指示にそのまま従うことである。
99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.gloss: 理由を聞かずに権威に従う姿勢。

99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.definition: 상대의 권위나 결정에 이유를묻지 않고 양복하는 태도나 습관이다. 단순한 존중이나 동의와 달리 이유에 대한 질문 없이 권위를 받아들이는 점이 특징이다.
99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.gloss: 권위에게 이유를 묻지 않고 readily 따르는 태도.

99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.definition: A atitude de aceitar a decisão de quem tem autoridade sem discutir ou questionar os motivos. É diferente do respeito, que pode existir junto com o pedido de explicação.
99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.gloss: O hábito de ceder à autoridade sem pedir a razão.

99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.definition: Sifat menghormati dan menaati otoritas tanpa bertanya mengenai alasannya. Kata ini mengandung maknapatrick yang tidak selalu negatif, tetapi perlu dibedakan dari ketakutan.
99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.gloss: Sifat tunduk kepada otoritas tanpa menuntut penjelasan.

99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.definition: นิสัยที่ยอมให้ผู้มีอำนาจตัดสินโดยไม่ตั้งคำถามหรือเรียกร้องเหตุผล แม้จะต่างจากการเคารพที่ยังพิจารณาข้อโต้แย้ง
99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.gloss: การยอมให้อำนาจตัดสินโดยไม่ถามเหตุผล

99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.definition: Üstün konumdakine karşı, soru sormadan ve sorgulamadan uyma eğilimidir. Tek başına zayıflık değildir; ancak herkesin yalnızca itaat ettiği bir ortamda denetleyecek kimse kalmaz.
99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.gloss: Otoriteye, nedenini sormadan teslim olma alışkanlığı.

99e88192e6caff022b5efd87f8ecb6f1901ba200.text: Deference is not weakness, but a room full of deference has nobody left to check anything.
